strings.zh: 施主请留步,{NEWLINE}游客参观到此结束。{CLEAR}再往前走就是供奉凤王的圣地了。{CLEAR}只有获得缘朱市道馆馆主的允许,{CLEAR}才能继续向上攀登。
strings.en: Please stop, traveler. The visitors’{NEWLINE}tour ends here. Beyond lies the sacred{CLEAR}ground where Ho-Oh is enshrined.{SCROLL}Only with the permission of Ecruteak{NEWLINE}City’s Gym Leader may you climb{CLEAR}any higher.

strings.zh: 这座塔里的精灵,{NEWLINE}也就是凤王,{CLEAR}一飞冲天后{CLEAR}就再也没有回来。{SCROLL}如果出现了能够和精灵{NEWLINE}建起深厚羁绊的训练师,{CLEAR}拿着和凤王有关联的物品,{SCROLL}凤王就有可能被吸引{NEWLINE}而再次降临……{SCROLL}
strings.en: Ho-Oh, the Pokémon that lived in this{NEWLINE}tower, soared into the sky{CLEAR}and never returned.{SCROLL}If a Trainer who can form deep bonds{CLEAR}with Pokémon comes here with something{CLEAR}linked to Ho-Oh, it may{CLEAR}be drawn back here...{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 啊！原来小松馆主说的那位{NEWLINE}带着彩虹羽毛的人就是你啊。{CLEAR}小松馆主已经跟我说过允许你上塔了。{CLEAR}请从这里通过吧！
strings.en: Ah! So you’re the one with the{NEWLINE}Rainbow Wing that Morty told me about.{CLEAR}Morty has already said you may go{CLEAR}up the tower.{SCROLL}Please, go on through!

strings.zh: 获得彩虹羽毛{NEWLINE}只是召唤凤王的第一步。{SCROLL}据说要让凤王现身,{NEWLINE}不仅需要彩虹羽毛和透明铃铛,{CLEAR}还要举行一个复杂的仪式。
strings.en: Obtaining the Rainbow Wing is only the{NEWLINE}first step to summoning Ho-Oh.{SCROLL}They say that to make Ho-Oh appear,{NEWLINE}you need not only the Rainbow{CLEAR}Wing and the Clear Bell, but also a{CLEAR}complicated ritual.

strings.zh: 原来如此,原来如此！{SCROLL}一切都是因为你和铃声吧！
strings.en: Hmmm.{SCROLL}So it was you and the Bell!

strings.zh: 施主年纪轻轻{NEWLINE}已有这种造化了啊……
strings.en: You are quite a remarkable Trainer{NEWLINE}for your age...

strings.zh: 小松『铃铛塔是确认人类和精灵{CLEAR}羁绊的地方。{SCROLL}你可能天生具有那种素质……{SCROLL}能和我互换一下电话号码吗？{SCROLL}我想多看看你和精灵{NEWLINE}之间的羁绊。{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Morty: Bell Tower is where{NEWLINE}people and Pokémon test their trust.{SCROLL}You may be born with some talent...{CLEAR}Can we exchange numbers?{SCROLL}I would love to examine the trust{NEWLINE}you have with your Pokémon. {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 小松『能在周二的晚上{NEWLINE}给我打电话吗？{SCROLL}那时候我可以再和你比试。
strings.en: Morty: Give me a call on Tuesday nights.{NEWLINE}I can battle you again then.

strings.zh: 这个铃铛塔中心{NEWLINE}也有根防震的大柱子,{CLEAR}跟桔梗市的喇叭芽之塔很像嘛。
strings.en: The Bell Tower has a big{NEWLINE}earthquake-proof pillar in the middle{CLEAR}too. It’s a lot like Sprout Tower in{CLEAR}Violet City.

strings.zh: 我每年都会带老婆孩子{NEWLINE}来铃铛塔祭拜凤王,{CLEAR}祈祷全家人健康平安。
strings.en: Every year I bring my wife and kids to{NEWLINE}the Bell Tower to worship Ho-Oh and{CLEAR}pray for the whole family’s health{CLEAR}and safety.

strings.zh: 我长大之后,{NEWLINE}也要成为凤王的训练家！
strings.en: When I grow up, I’m going to be Ho-Oh’s{NEWLINE}Trainer too!

strings.zh: 铃铛塔里有一股香气,{NEWLINE}是那种非常高雅清新的香味。
strings.en: There’s a fragrance in the Bell Tower.{NEWLINE}A really elegant, fresh scent.

strings.zh: 我专程从关东的枯叶市{NEWLINE}赶到这里来旅游。{CLEAR}可是管理塔的和尚们{CLEAR}却不让我上二层参观,{CLEAR}真是太小气了。
strings.en: I came all the way from Vermilion City in{NEWLINE}Kanto to see the sights here.{SCROLL}But the monks who run the tower{NEWLINE}won’t let me up to the second floor.{CLEAR}How stingy.

strings.zh: 凤王居然被火箭队抓走了！？{NEWLINE}守护城都的传说中精灵{CLEAR}竟然成了犯罪组织的打手！？{CLEAR}啊……难道这一切都是天意吗……
strings.en: Ho-Oh was captured by Team Rocket?!{NEWLINE}The legendary Pokémon that{CLEAR}protects Johto has become a criminal{CLEAR}gang’s muscle?!{SCROLL}Ah... Could all of this be the will{NEWLINE}of heaven...

strings.zh: 阿弥陀佛,多亏冠军大人{NEWLINE}带领我们击败了火箭队,{CLEAR}凤王才能重获自由。
strings.en: Amitabha. Thanks to you leading us to{NEWLINE}victory over Team Rocket, Champion,{CLEAR}Ho-Oh has regained its freedom.
